title: Noise pollution is reshaping the health and behaviour of animals everywhere | New Scientist
description: There is almost nowhere on Earth free from disruptive human noise – but it's one of the easiest environmental problems to solve
author: Madeleine Cuff

title: Did El Niño cause an early breakdown in the polar vortex? | New Scientist
description: The polar vortex winds have undergone an unprecedented weakening, which could bring cold weather to Europe. Some scientists suspect the record El Niño is to blame
author: Alec Luhn

title: Researchers build the first ever quantum clock that uses sunlight | New Scientist
description: Quantum clocks usually rely on advanced lasers and isolated atoms in the lab, but a new experiment showed that the same clock design can work with sunlight instead
author: Karmela Padavic-Callaghan

title: AI confirms a long-suspected limit on quantum computers’ advantages | New Scientist
description: An AI-powered proof has rigorously shown that using quantum computers wouldn't have huge advantages for a whole class of mathematical problems, confirming a vastly influential conjecture
author: Karmela Padavic-Callaghan

title: A robot has assembled a structure in space for the first time | New Scientist
description: Autonomous in-orbit manufacturing will be key to any future space economy, and researchers have taken the first step with a robot building a radio antenna without astronaut assistance
author: Leah Crane

title: Economics, not climate summits, will dictate the net-zero transition | New Scientist
description: World leaders at COP31 show little enthusiasm for phasing out fossil fuels, but the plummeting costs of renewable energy will be the key factor in how quickly we can rein in global warming
author: Alec Luhn
